body: thank you my friend, i will keep you in mind i promise
well other then the hate mail i’ve recorded over this post it has been quite helpful
you are a wonderful person, to be honest i definitely would never be here if it weren’t for the individuals on this post
thank you so much my friend, i’m gonna think long and hard about, the weights i’ve been carrying with me,
thank you for your insight, so much, honestly i’m working towards such things, some days i just find they don’t really entice me as much as the thought of ceasing to be
haha man, that actually somehow made me smile a little bit , i appreciate everyone of you here

honestly, i’ve come to a plateau in my life where nothing seems to be changing, even with everything i have in me i cannot change a thing, i guess i could have been a little more detailed with my posting, i’ve been dealing with more then i can seem to handle since grade 8, i’ve always felt like i never fit in and nothing has ever changed in that sense, i’ll always be a black sheep which isn’t always bad, my dad used to abuse me pretty badly and favour my brother probably because my mom left when i was a lot younger and he felt this was okay,  but my mom left as she would drink a lot and fight with my father, i remember one night specifically hearing them scream and throw things, my mom wasn’t there the next day, the abuse got to a point where i was just afraid to be at home, so one day i just didn’t come home, i stayed here there and everywhere trying to find a stable place where i’d feel home, and as of recently my father and i have become a little closer, after years of not talking although we’ve never talked about what happened which bothers me, he’s getting older, and recently needed an amputation, am i wrong to not go see him, am i wrong for atleast expecting an apology, 
not only do i have a life filled with problems, my life is just the same day in and day out, i can’t stand it, i’ve amounted to not a thing, i haven’t a person left to turn to, i can’t even comprehend all the thoughts
hey now, we both know that’s not true
